description: Comptage Mensuel 123 Boulevard Aristide Briand Vélos OUT is a dataset listed in Montreuil Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Eco-visio. Évolution mensuelle du nombre de vélos au 123 boulevard Aristide-Briand (2021 à aujourd'hui). Coverage: Montreuil. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, circulation douce, plan vélo. The portal shows 2,031 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-montreuil-fr-portal.
